title: Run outbound sales sequences
summary: Stand up outbound: build the target list in the CRM, draft and launch the sequence, monitor replies, book meetings, and qualify on the call.

parts.title: Build the target list
parts.guidance: Define target companies and contacts by the offer's relevant problem, role, location and exclusions. Build the list from authorized sources, keeping the source of each contact and removing duplicates, customers or suppressions as appropriate. Resolve outreach eligibility for the intended markets before transfer to a sending tool. Hold uncertain contact details or eligibility for review.

references.title: CAN-SPAM Act: A Compliance Guide for Business

parts.title: Draft the sequence copy
parts.guidance: Ground the sequence in a verified reason the offer may help its target group. Make the sender and next step clear, and have each follow-up add useful information. Include the audience's reviewed preference or opt-out handling. Hand exact messages, intended recipients and proposed cadence to launch setup, flagging unresolved claims or contact assumptions.

references.title: CAN-SPAM Act: A Compliance Guide for Business

parts.title: Set up and launch the sequence
parts.guidance: Load the messages and eligible audience into a draft sequence. Check the authorized sender, personalization, sending window, stop conditions and handling of replies, bounces and opt-outs. Run an internal test through the messages and CRM updates. Activate only the sales owner's agreed recipient set and cadence, with a named person able to pause unexpected sends.

references.title: CAN-SPAM Act: A Compliance Guide for Business

parts.title: Send and monitor replies
parts.guidance: Monitor delivery, replies, bounces and preference changes as the authorized sequence runs. Enforce its stop rules, record automated replies separately and route substantive responses to the account owner. Investigate sender or template failures before continuing affected sends. Update CRM dispositions and resolve any proposed audience or copy change outside the agreed campaign scope.

references.title: CAN-SPAM Act: A Compliance Guide for Business

parts.title: Book meetings with responders
parts.guidance: Reply with an agenda tied to the prospect's interest, available times and a timezone. Confirm participants and the meeting method, send the invitation through the account team's agreed process, and record the accepted slot. Pause overlapping sequence follow-ups.

parts.title: Qualify on the call
parts.guidance: Explore the prospect's workflow, desired outcome, stakeholders, constraints and decision process from their stated problem. Explain verified capabilities and escalate new commitments to the responsible owner. Record the prospect's answers, evidence for qualification and agreed next step, separating facts from the salesperson's interpretation.

metadata.supportReason: List building, sequencing, and scheduling run through CRM APIs behind a human send approval. Call qualification stays human.
